crime: For several weeks, a friend invited {WITCH_NAME} to share a table in the library and read selected passages aloud to her. {WITCH_NAME} always brought a small shoulder pouch with pencils, spare paper, and bookmarks the friend might need.

One afternoon, {WITCH_NAME} was sitting with the friend when another girl joined them. Holding out a pencil, she watched the friend turn toward the newcomer and take it without looking at her. She then began gathering her pouch, but the friend asked her to leave it behind because it contained everything they needed.

During evening free time, {WITCH_NAME} entered the empty lounge. She chose her small shoulder pouch as the only handheld container affected by her magic and kept one hand on it continuously. Its opening and interior expanded while its outer size remained unchanged. She put one of the lounge swords inside and closed the pouch.

{WITCH_NAME} asked the friend to finish their conversation in the library. They met there alone. She drew the sword from the pouch and drove it through the friend's chest at close range. The blade pierced the heart and major blood vessels, and the blood loss caused the friend's breathing and pulse to stop.

{WITCH_NAME} hid the bloody sword in the pouch again and left the library without breaking contact with it. A girl crossing the second-floor hall saw her leave carrying only her usual small pouch, then went downstairs. Before she could reach the lounge, a different girl entered the library, found the body, and called out. Prisoners filled the halls, leaving her no unseen route to return or discard the sword. They also found that one sword was missing from the lounge.

{WITCH_NAME} claimed the friend had been alive when she left and that someone else could have entered during the unwatched interval. One prisoner unfastened the shoulder strap, took it off her, and pulled the pouch entirely away. Once no part of the pouch or strap touched her, its opening and interior returned to their ordinary size. The rigid sword tore through the cloth, exposing a blade wet with blood.

The bloodied missing sword accounted for the chest wound. An ordinary pouch could not hold the sword, and the blade's forced emergence when the pouch lost contact with her showed that {WITCH_NAME} had used Interior Expansion to keep its interior enlarged while leaving the library. Her account of another killer could not explain why the weapon had remained concealed in the pouch she carried.
fields.epitaph: There was always room for what she brought, never for the person carrying it.
execution: A fixed iron feeding funnel clamps its narrow end over her mouth and holds her head back against the execution stand. Dry grain pours through it without stopping, forces her jaw open, and packs her mouth and throat faster than she can swallow or spit it out.
The funnel stays clamped over her mouth while the grain blocks her airway. She cannot breathe. Her chest stops moving, she loses consciousness, and her pulse stops.

magic.name: Interior Expansion
magic.text: She can enlarge a container's interior without changing its exterior.
